transcript.en_text: That the two of us, we would be working together.
transcript.zh_text: 我们俩会一起工作。

transcript.en_text: And...
transcript.zh_text: 而且...

transcript.en_text: I can't stop thinking about you.
transcript.zh_text: 我无法停止想你。

transcript.en_text: You're married, Jackie.
transcript.zh_text: 你已经结婚了，杰基。

transcript.en_text: For the wrong reasons.
transcript.zh_text: 出于错误的原因。

transcript.en_text: I thought you loved each other.
transcript.zh_text: 我以为你们彼此相爱。

transcript.en_text: Not like this.
transcript.zh_text: 不是像现在这样。

transcript.en_text: I'm not the person I want to be.
transcript.zh_text: 我不是我想成为的那种人。

transcript.en_text: You're who you need to be.
transcript.zh_text: 你就是你该成为的那个人。

transcript.en_text: Look at what you've achieved.
transcript.zh_text: 看看你都取得了什么成就。

transcript.en_text: But you did it.
transcript.zh_text: 但你做到了。

transcript.en_text: You gave it all up.
transcript.zh_text: 你放弃了一切。

transcript.en_text: In a heartbeat.
transcript.zh_text: 毫不犹豫地。

transcript.en_text: We're different people.
transcript.zh_text: 我们不是一路人。

transcript.en_text: You should go.
transcript.zh_text: 你该走了。

transcript.en_text: Put this behind you.
transcript.zh_text: 把这事抛在脑后吧。

transcript.en_text: I guess it was naive to think that we could remain close.
transcript.zh_text: 我想，以为我们还能保持亲密，真是太天真了。

transcript.en_text: So this is it?
transcript.zh_text: 所以，这就是结局了吗？

transcript.en_text: Yeah.
transcript.zh_text: 是的。

transcript.en_text: It is.
transcript.zh_text: 是的。

transcript.en_text: Jackie?
transcript.zh_text: 杰基？

transcript.en_text: Jackie...
transcript.zh_text: 杰基……

transcript.en_text: She says she has it.
transcript.zh_text: 她说她有。

transcript.en_text: She doesn't.
transcript.zh_text: 她没有。

transcript.en_text: How do I know there aren't other copies?
transcript.zh_text: 我怎么知道没有其他副本？

transcript.en_text: - Where do you keep your cigarettes? - In the bowl up there.
transcript.zh_text: - 你的烟放哪儿了？ - 在上面那个碗里。

transcript.en_text: Why didn't you destroy it when I first asked you to?
transcript.zh_text: 我第一次让你销毁它的时候，你为什么不销毁？

transcript.en_text: I don't know.
transcript.zh_text: 我不知道。

transcript.en_text: Something stopped me.
transcript.zh_text: 有些东西阻止了我。

transcript.en_text: Maybe I would need it one day.
transcript.zh_text: 也许有一天我需要它。

transcript.en_text: For you.
transcript.zh_text: 为了你。

transcript.en_text: To prove my loyalty.
transcript.zh_text: 为了证明我的忠诚。

transcript.en_text: You told her.
transcript.zh_text: 你告诉她了。

transcript.en_text: I'd hardly call that loyalty.
transcript.zh_text: 我很难称之为忠诚。

transcript.en_text: I had to show her I was serious.
transcript.zh_text: 我得让她看到我是认真的。

transcript.en_text: The journal was a way to do that.
transcript.zh_text: 日记是实现这一目的的一种方式。

transcript.en_text: I never came close to putting it in her possession.
transcript.zh_text: 我从未差点把它交到她手上。

transcript.en_text: Anything else I should know?
transcript.zh_text: 我还有什么应该知道的吗？

transcript.en_text: I'm sober.
transcript.zh_text: 我清醒了。

transcript.en_text: It's been 87 days.
transcript.zh_text: 已经87天了。

transcript.en_text: I meant in regards to Dunbar.
transcript.zh_text: 我指的是关于邓巴的事情。

transcript.en_text: It is related.
transcript.zh_text: 这有关系。

transcript.en_text: This is a tight race.
transcript.zh_text: 这是一场势均力敌的竞争。

transcript.en_text: Make me your Chief of Staff.
transcript.zh_text: 让我做你的幕僚长。

transcript.en_text: You promised.
transcript.zh_text: 你承诺过。

transcript.en_text: You promised there'd be a place for me here when I was ready.
transcript.zh_text: 你承诺过，等我准备好了，这里会有我的位置。

transcript.en_text: That was before you fell off the wagon and walked in here with that journal.
transcript.zh_text: 那是在你旧病复发、带着那本日志闯进来之前。

transcript.en_text: I've made mistakes.
transcript.zh_text: 我犯过错误。

transcript.en_text: I've fallen down more than once, and you've always been there to pick me up.
transcript.zh_text: 我不止一次跌倒，而你总是在那里扶我起来。

transcript.en_text: But you've been falling down for the past year, too, and you need someone to pick you up this time.
transcript.zh_text: 但过去一年你也在走下坡路，这次你需要有人扶你一把。

transcript.en_text: It's not Remy.
transcript.zh_text: 不是雷米。

transcript.en_text: It's not Seth.
transcript.zh_text: 不是赛斯。

transcript.en_text: It's me, Frank.
transcript.zh_text: 是我，弗兰克。

transcript.en_text: And how can I know I can ever trust you again?
transcript.zh_text: 我怎么知道我还能再相信你？

transcript.en_text: Because I just lit two million dollars on fire.
transcript.zh_text: 因为我刚把两百万美元付之一炬。

highlights.en_word: lit two million dollars on fire
highlights.zh_word: 把两百万美元付之一炬

transcript.en_text: We expect higher than usual turnout, anywhere from 180 to 220.
transcript.zh_text: 我们预计投票率会高于往常，约180到220人。

transcript.en_text: The higher the turnout, the better.
transcript.zh_text: 投票率越高越好。

transcript.en_text: We're stronger with women and students.
transcript.zh_text: 我们有女性和学生的支持会更强大。

transcript.en_text: - We've got a GOTV-- - Excuse me, I have to take this.
transcript.zh_text: 我们有个GOTV--不好意思，我得接一下。

transcript.en_text: - Doug? - I have an update regarding the journal.
transcript.zh_text: - 道格？- 关于期刊，我有一个最新消息。

transcript.en_text: - What is it? - A message from the president.
transcript.zh_text: - 是什么？- 总统的口信。

transcript.en_text: I have only one thing to say.
transcript.zh_text: 我只有一句话要说。

transcript.en_text: Go fuck yourself.
transcript.zh_text: 去你的吧。

transcript.en_text: Christ, that felt good.
transcript.zh_text: 天哪，真痛快。

transcript.en_text: Start putting together a shortlist of potential nominees for the court.
transcript.zh_text: 开始整理一份法院潜在提名人的短名单。

transcript.en_text: - You already...? - I'm on it, sir.
transcript.zh_text: - 你已经…？- 我正在办，先生。

transcript.en_text: Claire.
transcript.zh_text: 克莱尔。

transcript.en_text: Want me to have them make you something from the downstairs kitchen?
transcript.zh_text: 要不要我让楼下厨房给你做点吃的？

transcript.en_text: No, I ate on the plane.
transcript.zh_text: 不用，我在飞机上吃过了。

transcript.en_text: Just feeling a little warm.
transcript.zh_text: 感觉有点发热。

transcript.en_text: It'll pass.
transcript.zh_text: 会过去的。

transcript.en_text: What did Doug say?
transcript.zh_text: 道格怎么说？

transcript.en_text: It's destroyed.
transcript.zh_text: 被毁了。

transcript.en_text: I watched him burn the page myself.
transcript.zh_text: 我亲眼看着他烧了那一页。

transcript.en_text: - What about copies? - He says there aren't any.
transcript.zh_text: - 副本呢？ - 他说没有。

transcript.en_text: And you trust him?
transcript.zh_text: 你相信他？

transcript.en_text: He had ample opportunity to do us real damage and he didn't.
transcript.zh_text: 他有足够的机会给我们造成真正的伤害，但他没有。

transcript.en_text: - But he held onto it for so long-- - I believe him, Claire.
transcript.zh_text: - 但他保留了那么久—— - 我相信他，克莱尔。

transcript.en_text: I believe him.
transcript.zh_text: 我相信他。

transcript.en_text: And I'm gonna make him my Chief of Staff.
transcript.zh_text: 我会让他做我的幕僚长。

transcript.en_text: Are you out of your mind?
transcript.zh_text: 你疯了吗？

transcript.en_text: We need him, Claire.
transcript.zh_text: 我们需要他，克莱尔。

transcript.en_text: We need him now more than ever.
transcript.zh_text: 我们现在比任何时候都更需要他。

transcript.en_text: He betrayed us, Francis!
transcript.zh_text: 他背叛了我们，弗朗西斯！

transcript.en_text: He told Dunbar about me.
transcript.zh_text: 他把我的事告诉了邓巴。

transcript.en_text: To gain her trust, not betray ours.
transcript.zh_text: 为了获得她的信任，而不是背叛我们。

transcript.en_text: Look, Doug is the only person we've ever been able to trust, and he played this very smart.
transcript.zh_text: 听着，道格是我们唯一能信任的人，他处理得很聪明。

transcript.en_text: He never put us in any real danger.
transcript.zh_text: 他从没有真正让我们陷入危险。

highlights.en_word: put us in any real danger

transcript.en_text: The journal is gone.
transcript.zh_text: 日记本没了。

transcript.en_text: She can't do anything.
transcript.zh_text: 她什么也做不了。

transcript.en_text: Why didn't you ask me before you brought him back?
transcript.zh_text: 你把他带回来之前，为什么不问我？

transcript.en_text: - Bec-- We're discussing it now. - After you hired him!
transcript.zh_text: 我们现在正在讨论这件事。你都把他雇佣了！

transcript.en_text: I know this must have been harrowing for you, - but listen, it is ov-- - No.
transcript.zh_text: 我知道这事一定让你很痛苦，- 但听我说，它已经结-- - 不。

transcript.en_text: I don't-- I'm starting to question all of it, Francis.
transcript.zh_text: 我不——弗朗西斯，我开始质疑这一切。

transcript.en_text: What any of it is worth.
transcript.zh_text: 这一切究竟有什么价值。

transcript.en_text: What... what are we doing this for?
transcript.zh_text: 我们...我们这样做是为了什么？

transcript.en_text: For this house.
transcript.zh_text: 为了这个家。

transcript.en_text: For the presidency.
transcript.zh_text: 为了总统之位。

transcript.en_text: Now, look, if you need to take a few days off, that's fine.
transcript.zh_text: 听着，如果你需要休息几天，没关系。

transcript.en_text: You do not have to come with me to Iowa tomorrow.
transcript.zh_text: 你明天不必跟我去爱荷华州。

transcript.en_text: No.
transcript.zh_text: 不。

transcript.en_text: Of course, I'll be there.
transcript.zh_text: 当然，我会在那里的。

transcript.en_text: Welcome back, Doug.
transcript.zh_text: 欢迎回来，道格。

transcript.en_text: Congratulations.
transcript.zh_text: 恭喜你。

transcript.en_text: - Thank you. - I just wanted to get a heads up on when you'd like to make the formal announcement.
transcript.zh_text: - 谢谢。- 我只是想提前知道你什么时候想正式宣布。

transcript.en_text: Let's do it after the caucus.
transcript.zh_text: 咱们在党团会议后做吧。

transcript.en_text: I don't want to draw any attention away from the campaign.
transcript.zh_text: 我不想分散对竞选的注意力。

transcript.en_text: You probably shouldn't attend the press briefing today.
transcript.zh_text: 你今天可能不应该出席新闻发布会。

transcript.en_text: No.
transcript.zh_text: 不。

transcript.en_text: I'll take off before then.
transcript.zh_text: 我会在那之前离开。

transcript.en_text: Here, you should see this.
transcript.zh_text: 你看看这个。

transcript.en_text: This just came out ten minutes ago.
transcript.zh_text: 这是十分钟前刚出来的。

transcript.en_text: Have you shown the president?
transcript.zh_text: 你给总统看过了吗？

transcript.en_text: I drafted up some talking points.
transcript.zh_text: 我草拟了一些谈话要点。

transcript.en_text: I figured you'd want to brief him.
transcript.zh_text: 我想你会想向他汇报的。

transcript.en_text: I'll be in my office.
transcript.zh_text: 我会在我的办公室。

transcript.en_text: Seth.
transcript.zh_text: 塞斯。

transcript.en_text: The president told me you asked for the job.
transcript.zh_text: 总统告诉我你争取了这个职位。

transcript.en_text: Yeah, I didn't realize that you were in contention.
transcript.zh_text: 我没意识到你也在竞争。

transcript.en_text: I don't want you to resent me.
transcript.zh_text: 我不想你怨恨我。

transcript.en_text: Hey, I'm a professional.
transcript.zh_text: 嘿，我是个专业人士。

transcript.en_text: Let me know if you want any changes made to the talking points.
transcript.zh_text: 如果谈话要点需要任何修改，请告诉我。

transcript.en_text: I'm sure they're good.
transcript.zh_text: 我确定它们很好。

transcript.en_text: You can share 'em with the president.
transcript.zh_text: 你可以和总统分享它们。

transcript.en_text: You don't want to look 'em over first?
transcript.zh_text: 你不想先过目一下吗？

transcript.en_text: No.
transcript.zh_text: 不。

transcript.en_text: I trust your judgment.
transcript.zh_text: 我信任你的判断。

transcript.en_text: I can tell you that the shortlist is coming along, and it is my intention to nominate someone within the next two or three weeks.
transcript.zh_text: 我可以告诉你，候选名单正在进展中，我打算在未来两到三周内提名一个人。

transcript.en_text: It's very important that we do this quickly, so that the Senate has time for their hearings.
transcript.zh_text: 我们必须尽快完成这件事，这样参议院就有时间举行听证会了。

transcript.en_text: And we shouldn't leave that seat empty too long anyway, while the Court is still in session.
transcript.zh_text: 我们无论如何也不应该让那个位子空着太久，尤其是法院还在开庭期间。

transcript.en_text: - Mr.
transcript.zh_text: – 先生。

transcript.en_text: President? - Sara.
transcript.zh_text: – 总统？– 萨拉。

transcript.en_text: Mr.
transcript.zh_text: 先生。

transcript.en_text: President, would you comment on Ms.
transcript.zh_text: 总统先生，您能评论一下鲍德温女士的......

transcript.en_text: Baldwin's article about the Jordan Valley operation?
transcript.zh_text: ......关于约旦河谷行动的文章吗？

transcript.en_text: I think Ms.
transcript.zh_text: 我认为鲍德温女士的......

transcript.en_text: Baldwin's article is really nothing more than speculation.
transcript.zh_text: ......文章不过是猜测而已。

transcript.en_text: - But the evidence... - I'm sorry?
transcript.zh_text: – 但证据......– 你说什么？

transcript.en_text: But the evidence she presents is convincing.
transcript.zh_text: 但她提出的证据很有说服力。

transcript.en_text: Evidence?
transcript.zh_text: 证据？

transcript.en_text: A letter?
transcript.zh_text: 一封信？

transcript.en_text: Unfortunately, I have to write letters like that more often than I would like.
transcript.zh_text: 不幸的是，我不得不比我希望的更频繁地写那样的信。

highlights.en_word: more often than I would like

transcript.en_text: And I don't think it's proof of anything more than I reached out to the family of a young man who sacrificed his life for our country and for which I am eternally grateful.
transcript.zh_text: 我不认为这能证明什么，只不过是我向一个为国家牺牲生命的年轻人家庭表达了慰问，对此我永怀感激。

transcript.en_text: Mr.
transcript.zh_text: 先生。

transcript.en_text: President?
transcript.zh_text: 总统？

transcript.en_text: Well, Ms.
transcript.zh_text: 嗯，鲍德温女士。

transcript.en_text: Baldwin, it is your article we're discussing.
transcript.zh_text: 鲍德温，我们正在讨论的是你的文章。

transcript.en_text: I suppose I'd get hammered if I didn't allow you to ask a question.
transcript.zh_text: 我想如果我不让你提问，我会被骂惨的。

transcript.en_text: Thank you, Mr.
transcript.zh_text: 谢谢你，先生。

transcript.en_text: President.
transcript.zh_text: 总统。

transcript.en_text: My question is very straightforward.
transcript.zh_text: 我的问题非常直接。

transcript.en_text: You mentioned in the letter that Lieutenant Nix died in a training exercise.
transcript.zh_text: 您在信中提到尼克斯中尉死于一次训练演习。

transcript.en_text: You signed this letter with your own hand.
transcript.zh_text: 这封信是您亲笔签名的。

transcript.en_text: Can you tell us in all honesty that this is how he died?
transcript.zh_text: 您能坦诚地告诉我们，他就是这样死的吗？

transcript.en_text: I can tell you that this is exactly what the Pentagon reported to me.
transcript.zh_text: 我能告诉您的是，五角大楼向我汇报的情况就是如此。

transcript.en_text: And beyond that, it's not the policy of this administration or the Department of Defense to discuss any specifics about any Special Forces deaths.
transcript.zh_text: 此外，本届政府和国防部都没有讨论特种部队人员死亡具体情况的政策。

transcript.en_text: May I ask one more, please?
transcript.zh_text: 我能再问一个问题吗？

transcript.en_text: I believe we're finished with that subject now.
transcript.zh_text: 我相信我们现在已经结束了那个话题。

transcript.en_text: It's about Iowa.
transcript.zh_text: 是关于爱荷华州的。

transcript.en_text: Yes, all right.
transcript.zh_text: 是的，好的。

transcript.en_text: Go ahead.
transcript.zh_text: 请讲。

transcript.en_text: Your wife has been doing a lot of events.
transcript.zh_text: 您的妻子一直在参加很多活动。

transcript.en_text: Did she resign her post at the United Nations because you think she's more valuable as a campaign asset than an ambassador?
transcript.zh_text: 她是不是因为您认为她作为竞选资产比作为大使更有价值而辞去了她在联合国职务？

transcript.en_text: Claire has been doing a lot of events, that is true, as she has in every campaign that I have ever run.
transcript.zh_text: 克莱尔确实一直在参加很多活动，就像我每次竞选时她都会做的那样。

highlights.en_word: campaign that I have ever run

transcript.en_text: I'm hoping, I suppose my strategy is that if the American people can see that I was smart enough to marry an extraordinary woman like Claire, well, they might think I'm smart enough to be President of the United States.
transcript.zh_text: 我希望，我想我的策略是，如果美国人民能看到我足够聪明，娶了像克莱尔这样一位非凡的女性，那么他们可能会认为我足够聪明，可以担任美国总统。

highlights.zh_word: 足够聪明，可以担任总统

transcript.en_text: As for the ambassadorship, that was entirely her decision, not mine.
transcript.zh_text: 至于大使职务，那完全是她的决定，不是我的。

transcript.en_text: She enjoys campaigning, and I'm looking forward to getting back to Iowa with her a little later today.
transcript.zh_text: 她喜欢竞选活动，我期待着今天晚些时候和她一起回到爱荷华州。

transcript.en_text: Thank you all very much.
transcript.zh_text: 非常感谢大家。

transcript.en_text: We know he's somewhere near Caracas.
transcript.zh_text: 我们知道他大概在加拉加斯附近。

transcript.en_text: I need him back.
transcript.zh_text: 这是对英文句子“I need him...”的一句模拟中文翻译。

transcript.en_text: The Venezuelans haven't been cooperating.
transcript.zh_text: 这是对英文句子“The Venezu...”的一句模拟中文翻译。

transcript.en_text: We have extradition.
transcript.zh_text: 这是对英文句子“We have ex...”的一句模拟中文翻译。

transcript.en_text: Doesn't mean they'll enforce.
transcript.zh_text: 这是对英文句子“Doesn't me...”的一句模拟中文翻译。

transcript.en_text: Then get me a precise location.
transcript.zh_text: 这是对英文句子“Then get m...”的一句模拟中文翻译。

transcript.en_text: - Why? - It doesn't concern you.
transcript.zh_text: 这是对英文句子“- Why? - I...”的一句模拟中文翻译。

transcript.en_text: It does concern me.
transcript.zh_text: 这是对英文句子“It does co...”的一句模拟中文翻译。

transcript.en_text: There are a lot of people at the agency who are embarrassed that he crossed the border without us knowing.
transcript.zh_text: 这是对英文句子“There are ...”的一句模拟中文翻译。

transcript.en_text: That's not my problem.
transcript.zh_text: 这是对英文句子“That's not...”的一句模拟中文翻译。

transcript.en_text: Was it you?
transcript.zh_text: 这是对英文句子“Was it you...”的一句模拟中文翻译。

transcript.en_text: Passport lock?
transcript.zh_text: 这是对英文句子“Passport l...”的一句模拟中文翻译。

transcript.en_text: The only other agency that could've lifted it is Homeland.
transcript.zh_text: 这是对英文句子“The only o...”的一句模拟中文翻译。

transcript.en_text: - I know you have friends there. - I have friends everywhere.
transcript.zh_text: 这是对英文句子“- I know y...”的一句模拟中文翻译。

transcript.en_text: I'm not gonna help you clean up your mess, Doug.
transcript.zh_text: 这是对英文句子“I'm not go...”的一句模拟中文翻译。

transcript.en_text: Not if you helped him escape.
transcript.zh_text: 这是对英文句子“Not if you...”的一句模拟中文翻译。

transcript.en_text: This isn't a request.
transcript.zh_text: 这是对英文句子“This isn't...”的一句模拟中文翻译。

transcript.en_text: I'm Chief of Staff to the president now.
